title: Beyond Controllability: Speaker Diversity in Instruction-Guided Text-to-Speech
abstract: arXiv:2611.19030v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Instruction-guided text-to-speech (ITTS) lets users specify voice properties in natural language. Applications from conversational AI character voices to synthetic training data for downstream speech models depend on the system producing many distinct voices when the same broad category is requested repeatedly. No prior work audits whether ITTS outputs are in fact diverse, either compared to real speech or across attribute values. We evaluate seven open-source ITTS systems using speaker embeddings whose representational capacity we independently validate. Every system produces speaker distributions markedly narrower than real speech. Furthermore, female prompts produce less diverse voice pools than male prompts across most systems. In contrast, accent and emotion prompts barely alter speaker diversity in most systems, but reveal a strong controllability bias toward North American English and neutral speech. translated_title: 超越可控性：指令引导文本到语音中的说话人多样性
translated_abstract: 指令引导的文本到语音（ITTS）允许用户用自然语言指定语音属性。从对话式AI角色语音到下游语音模型的合成训练数据等应用，都依赖于系统在反复请求同一宽泛类别时能够生成许多彼此不同的声音。然而此前没有任何工作审计过ITTS的输出是否真正多样，无论是与真实语音相比，还是在不同属性取值之间进行比较。我们使用说话人嵌入对七个开源ITTS系统进行了评估，并独立验证了这些嵌入的表征能力。结果显示，每个系统生成的说话人分布都明显窄于真实语音。此外，在大多数系统中，女性提示所产生的声音池多样性低于男性提示。相比之下，口音和情感提示在大多数系统中几乎不改变说话人多样性，但暴露出系统在可控性上强烈偏向北美英语和中性语音。这些结果表明多样性……
tldr: 该论文首次审计了指令引导文本到语音系统的说话人多样性，发现七个开源ITTS系统生成的说话人分布远比真实语音狭窄，且女性提示的多样性更低、口音与情感控制明显偏向北美英语和中性语音。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first audit of speaker diversity in instruction-guided text-to-speech, revealing that seven open-source ITTS systems produce speaker distributions markedly narrower than real speech, with female prompts yielding less diverse voices and accent and emotion controls strongly biased toward North American English and neutral speech.
